## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d513fbcdb4e07d4bf1f4ac06db0d25d7b3f27e02`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md + scripts/pm/label-write.mjs
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: yes

Inputs read: card #35948 (body, triage, claim, both os-dev-report comments), PR #36214 (body, two files, net diff against merge base `cbd582f4b92b`), the check-runs on the head. Cited code read at the head, never reviewed: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`loadRecordRecognisers`, `readRecordThreads`, `recordVerdict`, `recordPassVerdict`, `narrowingDeclarationsIn`, `readChangesetTexts`, the narrowed leg), `record-recognisers.mjs` (`reviewFace`, `locateReviewOfRecord`, `servedTierStands`, `deliveredCardNumber`), `check-half-states.mjs` (`h43HandoffReading`, `h43GovernedReviewRequestGap`, `h48GovernedVerdictWithoutBrief`, `governedLandsOnRecord`), `check-governed-merges.mjs` (`testVerdict`, `applyGeneratedExceptions`, `pullPathsFrom`, `sizeLimbFires`, `landingTierOf`). None of those files, nor either file of the diff, moved on `main` between the merge base and `3f7fdd002130`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Public surface: none published. The diff touches one internal script and one governed skill line; no package, no schema, no generated output. Right.
- CLI accept set of `label-write.mjs`: one new mode flag `--handoff`, refused beside `--land`, `--release` and every label or assignee flag, and allowed without `--comment-file` only under `--dry-run`. `parseOptions` matches the header and the usage text. Right.
- New exports (`readGovernedTier`, `handoffTierVerdict`, `handoffReviewPlan`, `loadHandoffRecognisers`, `handoffSlice`, `handoffRowLines`, four `HANDOFF_*` constants) and two new `classifyOp` classes (`reviews-list`, `contents-read`): internal, additive, no existing class re-ordered into a different answer (`/pulls/N/reviews` did not match `pull-read` before). Right.
- New static namespace imports of `record-recognisers.mjs` and `check-handover.mjs`: the cycle note is plausible against the guard's own laziness rule, and the tooling self-test and PM dispatch-gates check-runs on the head are green, so the module graph evaluates. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: every run concluded success or skipped; Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint (all families), Type Check, Test Core and Dogfood Regression Gate success; Check Changeset skipped under `skip-changeset`.
- The accept set of the hand-off itself (which pulls the mode admits) is WRONG in one population: see M1.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` publish nothing. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body agree with the diff: no spec key, no accept set of a published package, no protocol shape moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation, base moved (dispatch named `fa304140`, branch cut at `cbd582f4`, `main` now `3f7fdd00`): accepted; no file the diff reads or edits moved since the merge base.
- Dev deviation, PR body not re-patched after the rework: the body is internally inconsistent (its Tests section says 382 cases, its Verification line still says 371). The seat's to patch; prose, not judged.
- Dev deviation, `Rule-change: yes` declared: verified below as `yes`. No `Ruling-ref:` line is on the body, so `ruled` is not available.
- Out-of-scope finding carried by #35612 (open): `governedReviewPlan` and the full-patrol H43/H48 read the `.claude/**` row path-only. Accepted as carried; the mode's own read-back does ask the rows on the post-split slice, as claimed.
- Out-of-scope finding, `execution-duties.md` line 17 still names the full patrol run as the per-round reader: To-do 3 of the card is therefore delivered as a capability (`--handoff --dry-run`) that no rule text points at. "Noted, not filed" is not a carrier. Escalated to the seat: file the follow-up card or the reading stays unread, which is the second half of the 2026-11-20 miss.
- Out-of-scope finding "carrier: none", a narrowing declared on the `Metadata-protocol:` line alone is not read: NOT accepted as out of scope. It is a divergence from the guard this mode says it copies; answered as S3, and it is the small end of M1.
- Claim line: the implementation ran under a stated exit from the tier the dispatch gates read as mandatory for `SKILL.md`, compensated by this review. Not ruled here; visible to the maintainer on the card, and the pull waits for him in any case.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the diff reads no data store.
- `open_questions`: empty in both reports.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, line 203.** The line now defines ③ as one stroke of `label-write.mjs --handoff` delivering ② and ③. Against the rule it sits under: line 194 (Tier H), and line 195, which gives the same terminal four-piece, ③ included, to a pull over 3000 lines OR one that declares a narrowing, with no Tier S exception. Against the card: the three writes, refused without ACCEPT and a same-head PASS. Byte budget 33859 of 33872, ratchet green.

**`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`.** What holds, each tried and not broken:
- Refusal order: kind, open state, tier, then reads, ACCEPT, PASS, brief, self-request, all before the comment is judged or anything is packed; every refusal returns through `nothing()` with no send. The direct route is refused at ③, still before a write.
- Tier: `handoffTierVerdict` refuses a fork first, admits Tier H or a firing size limb (a Tier S slice with the size limb firing is admitted, which line 195 requires), refuses Tier S and ungoverned; no verdict object is exit 3.
- PASS: the guard's own readers on the pull thread AND the delivered card, each cut to trusted authors by `readRecordThreads`; newest same-head record governs; unsigned, below-tier (exact, both directions), a non-PASS word, two verdict lines, a FAIL spelling, an open or unattributable grade all refuse through `recordPassVerdict`. No `runGit` is handed, so no carried record is accepted: stricter than the guard, never looser.
- ACCEPT: `h43HandoffReading`'s record, plus the newer-than-committer-date comparison; an undated record refuses.
- Read-back: `④ reviewers` against pending requests, `④ H43` and `④ H48` on `handoffSlice`, whose added Tier H entry does keep `governedLandsOnRecord` false on a Tier S or empty slice (`landingTierOf` is ALL-quantified), so the rows cannot stand down on a size-limb pull. Any ✗ is exit 4.
- Plan: author-approver assigned and never requested; covered approvers cost nothing.

Findings:

M1 (must-fix) — The mode refuses one of the three populations line 195 hands to the maintainer, and tells the seat nothing is owed. A pull that declares a narrowing, touches no governed path and stays under the size threshold lands by the maintainer (the guard's narrowed leg, ruling 2026-11-19 on #35321; SKILL.md line 195, 「或申报收窄同换终局四件套含③请审」). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` carries no narrowed limb (`humanMerge` is register, size or fork), so `handoffTierVerdict` falls to its last branch and prints "reads this pull as NOT governed ... nobody is owed a hand-off", exit 2. Line 203 now names this command as the way ③ is made, so a seat following the changed line on a narrowing pull is told by the instrument to hand nothing over, and no patrol row covers that population either: the 2026-11-20 miss, reproduced by the tool that closes it. Either admit a declared narrowing (the guard's exported `narrowingDeclarationsIn` over the body and the committed changesets, as its narrowed leg reads them, with the face held to narrowing), or make the refusal say that the mode does not judge a declared narrowing and that ③ is still owed by hand, and scope line 203 to match. A self-test pin on a narrowing-only pull either way.

S1 (should-fix) — A pull whose diff DELETES or RENAMES a changeset can never be handed off. `paths` comes from the tier tool's list, which holds removed files and every rename's `previous_filename` (`pullPathsFrom`); each `.changeset/*.md` in it is read with `GET /contents/PATH?ref=HEAD`, which answers 404 for a path the head does not hold, and the gate returns exit 3 "could not be read" on every run. The guard's own reader, `readChangesetTexts`, leaves a deleted changeset out as declaring nothing and tells it apart from a failed read. This happens on the tier route too, where the paths already decided the face and the changeset text is never consulted. Read a 404 on a changeset path as "not at the head, declares nothing" (or take the file statuses), and skip the read when the paths decide the face.

S2 (should-fix) — The idempotent exit ignores the brief half, so it can exit 0 with H48 still firing. With `pm:awaiting-merge` on, every approver covered, and NO `## 维护者速读` comment on the thread (the state a seat is in after repairing the label and the request by hand, as on 2026-11-20), a `--handoff` whose request carries the brief passes the brief check on the request's strength, then takes the "already handed off" branch and returns exit 0 without posting that request. The brief never reaches the thread, `now H48 ✗` is printed two lines above the line that says the pull is whole, and the card's acceptance ("a seat that runs only `--handoff` leaves the PR passing H43 and H48") fails on that pull. The whole-pull test must include `gate.hasBrief`; with no brief on the thread the comment is still owed. The no-file dry run takes the same branch and prints the same contradiction.

S3 (should-fix) — On a size-limb pull the review face is derived from less than the guard hands `reviewFace`, in two ways, so the tier a PASS must stand at can differ from the guard's. (a) `narrowingDeclared` is never set: a narrowing declared on the `Metadata-protocol:` line beside a bare `Clause-②:` line puts the guard on the narrowing face (`NARROWING_FACE_LINE`) and this mode on the declaration face, so a `TIER_DEFAULT` PASS the guard refuses is handed to the maintainer and the at-tier PASS the guard wants is refused here as below-tier. (b) `paths` is `hitPaths` plus `clearPaths`, and a path lifted as a pure regeneration is in neither (`applyGeneratedExceptions` records it under `exceptions`), while `reviewFace` reads the register pre-lift: a large pull whose only register hit is a regenerated file reads the rules face at the guard and the declaration face here. Hand `reviewFace` the tool's whole list (`exceptions[].path` included) and the guard's narrowing reading. The header sentence "the PASS the queue guard's way" is not true until then.

Nits, none affecting the verdict:
- N1 — `isChangesetFile` re-spells `record-recognisers.mjs`'s private `isChangesetPath` under a header that says nothing is re-spelled; export the one.
- N2 — `reviews-list` reads one page of 100; a later page's approver reads uncovered and is requested again. Harmless direction.
- N3 — `handoffReviewPlan` matches logins case-insensitively and H43 matches exactly; on a case-different login the plan reads covered and the row reads ✗.
- N4 — `--handoff --dry-run` exits 0 whatever `now H43` / `now H48` read; as the per-round reading it is text-only, which a patrol script cannot branch on.
- N5 — the ACCEPT is read from any commenter (H43's existing reading, not this diff's): only the PASS is author-bound.

Rule-change check: the changed line makes the hand-off to the maintainer conditional on an instrument's gates (tier, ACCEPT age, face tier, brief) and, per M1, changes which pulls reach him in practice. That alters what goes to him and how, it copies no quoted ruling, so the declared `yes` is verified as `yes`: the pull waits for the maintainer.

Security check: line 203 teaches no permission, credential, token or authentication behaviour; the script hunks reuse the guard's existing record-author binding and add none.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `27e6000b1a1efe5c32d2db37ee34f66f6de9ca0e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + scripts/pm/label-write.mjs
Rule-change-verified: yes

Delta round on the FAIL record 7075527312 (head `d513fbcd`). Inputs read: card #35948 (body, triage, claim, the three os-dev-report comments), PR #36214 (body, three files, the net diff against merge base `cbd582f4b92b` and the fix delta `d513fbcd..27e6000b`), the 48 check-runs on the head. Cited code read at the head, never reviewed: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`narrowedReading`, `narrowingDeclarationsIn`, `readChangesetTexts`, `recordVerdict`, `NARROWING_FACE_LINE`, the narrowed leg), `record-recognisers.mjs` (`reviewFace`), `check-governed-merges.mjs` (`LOW_RISK_CHANGESET_PATH`, `applyGeneratedExceptions`, the `hitPaths` / `clearPaths` / `exceptions` shape), `check-half-states.mjs` (`h43GovernedReviewRequestGap`, `h48GovernedVerdictWithoutBrief`, `h48SpeaksAbout`). `main` moved since the merge base in three of those files (#36215 for #35612, landed 06:36Z as `b78b14cc`); the exports this diff calls kept their signatures there.

Closure of the earlier findings:

- M1: closed
- S1: closed
- S2: closed
- S3: closed

### ① Derived judgments

- Public surface: none published. One internal script and two governed skill lines; no package, schema or generated output. Right.
- Accept set of the hand-off (which pulls the mode admits): now three populations, Tier H, the size limb, and a declared narrowing on a new `narrowed` route, admitted whatever the register reads, Tier S included; a fork, and a Tier S or ungoverned pull that declares nothing, are refused. This is SKILL.md line 195 in full. Right, and it is the M1 correction.
- CLI: no new flag. One new exit code, 7 (`EXIT_HANDOFF_OWED`), for `--handoff --dry-run` alone, declared in the header's exit table and exported. A dry run that used to exit 0 with a ✗ row now exits 7; nothing in the tree branches on the old 0 (no caller of `--handoff` exists outside this file). Right.
- New exports `handoffOwesDeclarations` and `EXIT_HANDOFF_OWED`; `handoffTierVerdict` gains a second, defaulted parameter; `isChangesetFile` is gone in favour of the tier tool's exported `LOW_RISK_CHANGESET_PATH`; two more names are imported from the guard (`narrowedReading`, `NARROWED_RULING`). Internal and additive. Right.
- Per-round reader (execution-duties line 17): moves from the full `check-half-states.mjs` run, which read governed Tier H only and left a size-limb pull to a self-read, to the dry run per pull, which reads all three populations. A widening of what the reader covers, at one tier-tool spawn per pull. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: every one concluded success or skipped. Success: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, every Lint family (PM dispatch-gates and the tooling self-tests among them), every Type Check family, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate. Check Changeset skipped under `skip-changeset`.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` publish nothing. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body agree with the diff: no spec key, no accept set of a published package, no protocol shape moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Earlier escalation, execution-duties line 17 "noted, not filed": answered inside the PR. The line is in the diff and the self-test pins it as a substring.
- Dev deviation, base not merged (`main` at `b3bcfefc` at report time): accepted. The pull reads mergeable and clean, and the byte budgets hold after the merge by arithmetic: SKILL.md 33869 on `main` less 4 is 33865 of 33872; execution-duties 20154 on `main` less 5 is 20149 of 20154.
- Dev deviation, new exit code 7: accepted, see ①.
- Dev deviation, a changeset read over REST `GET /contents` with 404 read as "not held", where the guard asks `git ls-tree`: accepted. The path comes from the pull's own file list and is read at the head's sha on the token that just read the pull; every other status is exit 3. The residual (a 404 that is not absence) fails toward a refusal or a cheaper face, and is small enough to leave; a later hardening could take the file status from the pull's file list.
- Dev deviation, one ablation attempt crashed and measured nothing, replaced by a measuring mutation: accepted as declared.
- Dev deviation, `Rule-change:` stays `yes`: verified below.
- Out-of-scope finding carried by #35612: that card's fix is on `main` (`b78b14cc`). Nothing is owed here; see N7 for the two sentences it made stale.
- Out-of-scope finding, N2, N3 and N5 not taken, "carrier: seat": nits, so not taking them is allowed, but a seat is not a carrier. Escalated to the seat: file one follow-up card or state them as accepted deviations in the seat record.
- Claim line: the stated exit from the tier the dispatch gates read as mandatory for `SKILL.md` was argued on "one pointer line". The diff now rewrites a second governed line, in `execution-duties.md`, which the claim's `File surface:` does not name. Not ruled here. Escalated to the seat: amend the claim's file surface, and keep the exit visible to the maintainer, who approves this pull in any case.
- PR body: it now names the third file and the round-3 counts. Its Acceptance notes still call #35612 "the open card" and say the full patrol stands down on a `.claude/**` pull declaring `Rule-change: yes`; both are untrue of `main` since `b78b14cc`. Prose, the seat's to patch, not judged.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the diff reads no data store.
- `open_questions`: empty in all three reports.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, line 203** (unchanged since `26da765b`). It names `label-write.mjs --handoff` as the one stroke for ② and ③. Line 195 gives the same terminal four-piece, ③ included, to a pull over 3000 lines or one that declares a narrowing, with no Tier S exception; the command now admits all three, so the line holds for every pull the rule sends through it. 「Tier S 不交人」 on line 204 agrees with the code: a Tier S pull is refused only when it declares no narrowing, and the refusal says so.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, line 17.** 「每 PR 跑 `label-write.mjs --issue PR --handoff --dry-run`,含超行与收窄;7 即缺件」, read against the code:
- 含超行与收窄: true. The dry run runs the same gate, so the size limb and the narrowed route are both read, and the two rows are asked on `handoffSlice`, which carries a Tier H entry for either.
- 7 即缺件: true in the direction it is written. Exit 7 is reached only past the gate with a `now` row reading ✗. Exit 0 is sound as "whole": it needs an ACCEPT newer than the head, a same-head PASS at the face's tier, the label, every approver covered and a brief on the thread. No missing piece reads 0, except under N3.
- Against line 16, the duty it serves (席位记录 / `pm:awaiting-merge` / 请审 / 终版速读 at the current head): the last three read 7; the first reads 2, see N6.
- The rule dropped, 「超行无受管 PR 自读」, is replaced by the instrument reading that population. Nothing a seat owed before is owed by nobody now.

**`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`**, the fix delta, each tried and not broken:
- M1. `handoffTierVerdict` returns the `narrowed` route when the guard's own `narrowedReading` finds a declaration on the body or a changeset committed at the head. The order is fork, Tier H, unread declarations (exit 3, never a pass), size, narrowed, then the two refusals, and both refusals now name the missing declaration. `handoffSlice` adds one Tier H entry on that route, so `governedLandsOnRecord` cannot stand H43 and H48 down on a Tier S or empty slice. Pinned with a control: the same pull declaring `none` is refused with zero sends.
- S1. `readHeadChangesets` skips a 404, returns NOT MEASURED on any other failed read, and is not called on the tier route (`handoffOwesDeclarations` is false for a fork and for Tier H). On the tier route `recordVerdict` is handed no `declaredOn`, which is the guard's governed entry; a Tier H reading always holds a register hit, so `reviewFace` decides on the paths before any declaration would be read.
- S2. The idempotent exit now requires `gate.hasBrief`. With the label on, every approver covered and no brief on the thread, a request carrying the brief goes out as a comment-only stroke and H48 reads clean after; a request without one is refused; the no-file dry run exits 7 and never prints "already handed off". The idempotence test is H48's own conjunction (label and brief), so the two cannot disagree.
- S3. `paths` is the union of `hitPaths`, `clearPaths` and every `exceptions[].path`, so a path lifted as a pure regeneration reaches `reviewFace` as it does at the guard. Off the tier route the pair carries the guard's `declaredOn` (body, then each changeset text) and `narrowingDeclared`, which `recordVerdict` turns into `NARROWING_FACE_LINE`. The header sentence "the PASS the queue guard's way" is now true of the face as well.
- N1 and N4 of the earlier record are taken: the guard's `LOW_RISK_CHANGESET_PATH` is imported, and the dry run exits 7 on a ✗ row.
- Refusal order unchanged in kind: every read and refusal still precedes the comment and the pack, and each returns with zero sends.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits, none affecting the verdict:
- N2, N3, N5 of record 7075527312 stand as written, not taken. N3 has one more consequence on this head: on a case-different approver login the plan reads covered and H43 reads ✗, so a dry run can take the "already handed off" exit 0 beside a `now H43 ✗` line, against the header's "exit 7 when a `now` row reads ✗". GitHub returns canonical login case, so this needs a mis-cased entry in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`.
- N6: as the per-round reader, exit 2 covers both "nothing is owed" (Tier S, ungoverned, a fork, a closed pull) and "a piece is missing before the rows can fire" (no ACCEPT, an ACCEPT older than the head, no same-head PASS). The refusal sentence tells them apart and 0 is never reached, so no missing piece reads as whole; but line 17 names only 7, and a head that moved after a hand-off, the case line 16 exists for, reads 2. A later wording could say that any non-zero exit is read by its sentence.
- N7: the header sentence that `governedReviewPlan` "reads the `.claude/**` row path-only, so it would request nobody" describes `main` before `b78b14cc`; it is stale the moment this merges. The decision not to call it is unaffected.

Rule-change check: line 203 makes the hand-off to the maintainer one instrument's stroke, conditional on its gates (population, ACCEPT age, the face's tier, the brief), and line 17 changes what a seat runs each round and which pulls that reading covers. Both alter what is done and what reaches him; the body carries no `Ruling-ref:` line, so `ruled` is not available. The declared `yes` is verified as `yes`: the pull waits for the maintainer.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感。车队内部:席位把 Tier H 的 PR 交给你审批时,原来要分三步写(席位记录评论、挂 `pm:awaiting-merge`、请你审),现在 `label-write --handoff` 一笔中继做完,并先核对三件是否齐全;少一件就拒绝并说出少了哪件。
- 为什么做:多次出现交接漏一步(没挂标签或没请审),PR 就停在那里没人知道(卡 #35948)。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是交接工具拒绝了本该放行的 PR,席位退回手工三步;不碰产品代码,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:批准本 PR(它声明 `Rule-change: yes`,改了车队技能的交接规则,只能由你批)。合同审查 PASS 记录是评论 7076207941,Head-sha `27e6000b1a1efe5c32d2db37ee34f66f6de9ca0e`。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。第一轮审查 FAIL 的 M1(声明为收窄的 PR 无法交接)和 S1–S3 均已在本 head 关闭;剩下的五个细节已立成后续卡 #36356,不影响本 PR。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36214` CLEAN(13 项无标记);draft、base `main`、`Fixes #35948`;3 个文件 +696 −32;`skip-changeset` 正确,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`、`Rule-change: yes`(无 `Ruling-ref:`)。
- 前提实测:`check-governed-merges --pr 36214` 读到 `.claude/**` 声明拆分为 Tier H,728 行 ≤ 3000;审查按合并后算术核过两个文件的字节上限仍守住(`SKILL.md` 33865/33872、`execution-duties.md` 20149/20154)。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `27e6000b1a1efe5c32d2db37ee34f66f6de9ca0e`:26 success · 22 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending(含 Queue Guard、PR 正文门禁、Test Core、Dogfood)。
